{{Quote|What's nelab stew?"<br />"You don't want to know&mdash;especially if you're going to eat it.|[[Ben Skywalker]] and [[Unidentified Big Boom bartender]]|<ref name="Legacy of the Force: Invincible">''[[Legacy of the Force: Invincible]]''</ref>}}
'''Nelab stew''' was a type of [[Stew/Legends|stew]] served on the [[Big Boom]] [[Cantina/Legends|cantina]] on [[Nova Station]] for ten [[Galactic Credit Standard/Legends|credits]].<ref name="Legacy of the Force: Invincible" />
